description:
Welcome! 
 
 Our Growth is Creating Great Opportunities! 

 Our team is expanding, and we want to hire the most talented people we can.    Continued success depends on it!   Once you've had a chance to explore our current open positions, apply to the ones you feel suit you best and keep track of both your progress in the selection process, and new postings that might interest you! 

 Thanks for your interest in working on our team! 
 
 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and enhance automated testing solutions for next-generation Wi‑Fi and broadband networking products. This role will focus on test automation, CI/CD pipeline development, software quality initiatives, and validation infrastructure support.
 The ideal candidate will have strong Python development skills and experience with Jenkins, GitHub, and Artifactory. Candidates with networking knowledge, particularly Wi‑Fi, TCP/IP, and Cisco technologies, will have an advantage in this role.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks for Wi‑Fi and networking products.
 Create Python-based tools and utilities to support product validation, test execution, and data analysis.
 Develop and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing and release validation.
 Integrate automated testing into GitHub-based development workflows.
 Manage software artifacts and package repositories using Artifactory.
 Collaborate with software development, quality assurance, and product engineering teams to improve test coverage and product quality.
 Analyze test results, troubleshoot failures, and identify root causes of software and system defects.
 Support regression, feature, performance, and interoperability testing activities.
 Contribute to lab automation initiatives and test infrastructure improvements.
 Document software designs, test automation frameworks, procedures, and best practices.
 Participate in code reviews and drive adherence to software quality standards.
 Support customer issue reproduction and validation efforts when required.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field; equivalent industry experience will be considered.
 3+ years of software development or test automation experience.
 Strong proficiency in Python development.
 Experience with: Jenkins
 GitHub
 Artifactory
 Linux environments
 Git version control
 
 Experience developing automated test solutions and supporting CI/CD workflows.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience testing networking, broadband, wireless, or telecommunications products.
 Understanding of networking fundamentals including: TCP/IP
 DHCP
 DNS
 Routing and switching concepts
 Ethernet technologies
 
 Familiarity with Cisco IOS configuration and troubleshooting.
 Knowledge of Wi‑Fi technologies including: 802.11ac
 802.11ax (Wi‑Fi 6)
 802.11be (Wi‑Fi 7)
 
 Experience with REST APIs and test automation frameworks.
 Familiarity with containerized environments and automation tools.
 Experience with performance testing, throughput testing, and network protocol analysis.
 Desired Skills 
 Passion for software quality and automation.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
 Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis capabilities.
 Detail-oriented with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
 Able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic engineering environment.
